issues.reason: Thematic roles puts an entity an event befalls in Patient (it changes) or Theme (it does not), so (To $e $h) binds a slot no answering statement parse would ever fill and the line asks for an event directed at the harvest rather than one that happens to it.

The frame half stands — once (Member $e $verb) abstracts the class, the To conjunct is licensed by nothing but the 'happen to' frame the abstraction discarded — but the PurposeOf half overstates, since a query line is never asserted and so no seeded bridge fires on it; the real, smaller hazard is that the line can spuriously match a stored purpose atom (To <event> <harvest-event>), 'harvest' being an event-noun.

gaps_confirmed: "What happens to X?": Queries supplies only the agentive pro-verb template (Member $e $verb) (Agent $e $b), and no role head may be a variable, so a participant whose role in the answering event is unknown cannot be asked for
"happen to" in its befall sense is uncovered: happen is addressed only as a light verb over an event-noun subject ("the ceremony happened in March"), never with a to-PP naming the affected entity
new_gaps: To is overloaded and arity does not separate the senses: the binary purpose connective (To <main-event> <purpose-event>) and the preposition-named oblique (To <event> <entity>) share head and arity, and with an event-noun ('harvest', 'ceremony', 'show') in the second slot they are indistinguishable — the two Yet senses get an explicit arity disambiguator, To gets none

No licensed union over alternative ROLES for one asked participant: Dual-storage union enumerates alternative storage heads (exact vs bound, Time vs TimeAtLeast, …), not alternative roles, and the question is not disjunctive, so even the Patient-branch-union-Theme-branch fallback that a 'what happens to X' question needs is itself unlicensed
defect_summary: The nearest compliant form swaps the To conjunct for the role the answering event would actually carry — (: $prf (And (Member $e $verb) (Patient $e $h) (Member $h thread_harvest)) $tv) plus the parallel Theme line — but no form the instruction set licenses can ask for the harvest in whatever role it plays (a role head cannot be a variable and no role-union device is defined), so there is no fully faithful fix; filed in new_gaps.
notes: The rest of the line is sound: a single query, the $prf/$tv wrapper, $verb in the class slot on the "What does Bob do?" precedent, the definite bound by kind because the context holds no thread-harvest referent, no status pin for the simple present, and nothing asserted.
